# R316 — XeStrata b9 numerical route divergence triage

Date: 2026-10-13
Scope/status: source-level comparison of pristine da3d426 and b9f00e9 plus the closed compact W result summary. No tests, builds, GPU/model/profiler/process access, active-run receipt reads, Git commands, or source edits were performed. This is not a numerical-equivalence or quality finding.

## Closed comparison facts

The closed W summary at bench/results/2026-10-13-xe-b9-update/REPORT.md records same-hash 32,768-token input, output length 16, first eight generated IDs equal, ninth ID different, and LP5 different. Both completed ordinary serve with segmented verifier forced on, resident graph/copy engine off, no MTP, batch off, pipeline setting 1, 8,192-token chunks, and 128/144 expert cache slots. It records normal quit and no runtime/kernel fault. New b9's single diagnostic measured prefill 97,544.6 ms (335.928 t/s) and decode 2,214.8 ms (7.224 t/s); the old da sample is a single historical reference. These are not a paired timing comparison. Output divergence establishes lack of demonstrated numerical equivalence; it does not establish a model-quality regression. Equal first-eight IDs do not imply equal logits or recurrent state, and LP5 difference indicates additional distribution differences.

## Highest-priority source-level divergence candidates

**1. New prompt-side MMQ eligibility for Q2_K (strongest specific source candidate, conditional on the actual per-layer format).** In old src/kernels/xe/iq_mmq.cpp:625-629, supported expert types are 16, 17, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23, 29 and 42; type 10 (GGML Q2_K) is absent. In b9 at 960-965, type 10 is newly supported, with a new Dec<10> implementation at 382-408 and duplicated activation rows (iq_mmq_type_dup, quantize at 994-1029). Q2_K encodes a scale/min affine term per sub-block; this path represents it as two products over duplicated q8 activations. It is a quantized integer-product approximation, not the same arithmetic as the prior FP16 expert fallback. The new MmqPlan enables each layer only when both GU and Down types are supported and the GU layout is contiguous (prefill.cpp:650-675); it uses MMQ by default when the implementation reports usable matrix/DP4a kernels, unless STRATA_PREFILL_MMQ=0 (:657-660). Therefore, if any run-relevant layer's Down tensor is type 10, b9 can select MMQ where da left that layer on FP16 fallback. The model label IQ3_S does not establish every expert tensor's type. Obtain per-layer GU/up/Down types and actual mmq_plan selection before assigning cause. The new support can be numerically legitimate but still shift hidden states and token margins.

STRATA_PREFILL_MMQ=0 is a source-defined b9 switch to disable this route for a prompt-side control. It cannot undo other source changes and should be run only as a fresh-process single-factor comparison after Main's route/synchronization admission. The relevant implementation reference is the primary ggml Q2_K layout/dequant implementation: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/ggml/src/ggml-quants.c

**2. Model metadata now supplies broader geometry (configuration divergence to rule out first).** Old generate.cpp initializes canonical ModelGeometry and reads only qwen4exp expert_count, expert_used_count, and RoPE keys. b9 calls read_model_spec plus geometry_from_spec, then reads expert counts, RoPE and the rest of model geometry from that spec (old generate.cpp:3343-3359; new:3428-3448). ModelSpec reads architecture-prefixed dimensions including layer count, context, attention head/key/value sizes, RoPE dimensions/sections and SSM/KDA fields (include/strata/artifact/model_spec.hpp:145-189). This is likely a metadata-driven correction, but an identical weight hash alone cannot prove equal effective geometry. Compare old/new INFO values and resolved per-layer geometry, especially attention dimensions, RoPE base/scaling/dimensions and GDN shapes. A real change here can alter route or positions and is separate from kernel precision.

**3. One-token QSA attention was generalized, with the Qwen shape still using the same nominal 8-value lane width.** Old qsa_decode_attn.cpp specializes HD=256/G=12 and accumulates eight key-query products as an explicit expression (old lines 185-220). b9 templates HD/G and calls dotn<N> with N=HD/32 (new lines 119-140, 205-233); for Qwen's 256-wide head this remains N=8. Both source forms are left-to-right sums and the value fold remains ordered, so this is a lower-priority candidate than the newly reachable MMQ arithmetic; contraction/inlining/compiler code generation still merits a direct single-step comparison. The one-token path calls qsa_decode_attn_step when fast attention is on (src/core/layer.cpp:1121-1124); because the route has no MTP/batching, new multi-query QSA paths are not selected. New n_rot support for full-head RoPE does not affect Qwen if it keeps the existing 64-wide rotation; verify actual RoPE geometry.

**4. GDN and verifier refactoring has a clear Qwen default but is not zero-risk by inspection.** b9 introduces gdn_set_silu_gate; the header says false is qwen4exp's existing sigmoid(z) gate and true is qwen35moe's SiLU(z) (include/strata/kernels/gdn.hpp:94-106). New prefill and verify kernels pass this setting; with correct Qwen architecture dispatch, the default preserves the old sigmoid rather than silently switching to SiLU. The generic 16-key/48-value recurrence is intended to retain the earlier Qwen arithmetic (prefill/kernels.cpp, old hard-coded shapes versus b9 Gdn<HK,HV> dispatch); exact route/kernel choice and intermediate values still need state comparison. The new multi-hit MoE combine and batched QSA/Q8 normalization are gated on n>1 / batch and are excluded by this run's batch=0 settings. Route-resident's new parallel replacement is gated by positive STRATA_ROUTE_RESIDENT margin; default is zero (verify.cpp:110-124,1087-1093), so it should not be attributed without effective startup settings proving otherwise.

## Interpretation and ranked next comparison

First record one compact source-switch comparison that captures the full vocabulary logits immediately after the 32K prompt and at every one-token decode step for the identical known token prefix. Record maximum absolute/relative logit error, top-1 margin, top-5 IDs/logits and the earliest token step where the distributions differ; hash full tensors and keep only compact summaries unless a current numerical-failure investigation explicitly needs raw tensors. Also compare effective model geometry, the actual per-layer expert types, selected MMQ bitmap, and free/contrib LLVM/runtime pins. Existing token IDs and LP5 cannot localize the first numerical divergence.

If the first significant difference is already in post-prompt logits, repeat b9 with only STRATA_PREFILL_MMQ=0, same prompt IDs/chunk/cache/compiler/runtime, and collect the same logits. Compare this b9 fallback to da3d426 at the same prompt boundary. A collapse of the early logit difference would implicate the newly selected prefill MMQ route; persistence would leave geometry, GDN and other prefill arithmetic open. If post-prompt logits are effectively the same but differences emerge during one-token decode, use an isolated QSA fast-attention source switch or a CPU/reference one-step fixture on the exact cache mode and compare Q, KV selected cells, attention scores, attention output and final logits for the same prior token state. Keep those as separate arms.

Do not patch both stages together, infer equivalence from first-eight IDs, or call this a quality regression. For quality, a separate protocol needs model-appropriate held-out prompts and a declared evaluation method after numerical localization; one prompt and 16 outputs cannot establish that conclusion. The source switches and state capture proposed here are next actions for Main only; no tests or reruns were done in this triage.
